title: BHOC CRADA Research Partnership Call | BHOC Veterinary
description: BHOC invites research partners in Precision Oxygen Therapeutics, veterinary medicine, wildlife rescue and other applications, drawing on the CRADA model.
heading: Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA)
lead: We are announcing an open call for partners interested in joint research and development with BHOC, based on the CRADA model.

image.alt: BHOC CRADA research-partner banner with a veterinarian, dog, cat, elephant, researcher, two dachshunds and mitochondria, inviting human, veterinary and wildlife oxygen-delivery research.

socialImage.alt: BHOC CRADA research-partner banner with a veterinarian, dog, cat, elephant, researcher, two dachshunds and mitochondria, inviting human, veterinary and wildlife oxygen-delivery research.

imageCaption: Open call for research partners in Precision Oxygen Therapeutics. BHOC artwork with Rem and Eva.
introduction: Our focus is Precision Oxygen Therapeutics. BHOC stands for Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier.
principle: Oxygen is the same, and the basic biochemistry is shared.
otherAreas: And many other areas where mitochondrial support is needed.
invitation: We invite researchers, doctors, veterinarians and institutions to discuss what we can study together and what each partner can contribute.
contactText: If you are interested in working with us, please get in touch.
researchNote: These are proposed research areas. Product- and species-specific safety and efficacy require their own evidence.
